text:
maya: quick thread — after launch of search-relevancy v1 we're seeing a mix of regressions + enhancement asks from a few customers. want to align on rules for bugs vs enhancements for the next 2 sprints.

alex: can we get a short list of current issues? I grabbed a quick matrix: 1) result ordering regression (customers A, B) 2) embeddings mismatch on long queries 3) snippet formatting enhancement request. which are true regressions vs feature asks?

tom: result ordering is a clear regression (P0) — breaks core flow. embeddings mismatch looks like a P1 (edge-case for long tails). snippet formatting is enhancement. repro + fix: 2d for hotfix + 1d spike.

maya: proposed triage rules: P0 = user-facing incorrect results that materially degrade product flows -> immediate patch/hotfix. P1 = correctness edge-cases affecting small % -> schedule in bug sprint. Enhancements -> groom/prioritize by impact vs effort. sound reasonable?

sara: two paying customers flagged this as causing support escalations — one is enterprise with SLA. can we bump those to P0? they're threatening churn. :grimace:

javier: if both go P0 it'll push our dedicated capacity and delay other roadmap items. suggestion: create a 'customer hotfix' lane — quick patch for paying customers (fast-track) + mainline bug fix in the regular sprint so we don't diverge forever.

alex: implementation idea: fast repro -> backport minimal fix -> canary behind a feature flag per-org. deploy steps roughly:
```
- branch: hotfix/search-ordering
- tests: add golden-case reproducer
- release: canary -> select orgs -> full roll
```
opsbot: deploy-bot: created deploy plan draft (ID: dp-874), next-deploy scheduled 03/14 02:00 UTC.

tom: dev plan: 1) repro + unit test 2) small patch + backport 3) canary flagging per org. estimate: 3 engineers ~1 day for initial hotfix scope.

maya: decision for now: create two lanes — 'hotfix-customer' (SLA <=24h for paying customers) and 'bug-sprint' (P1 and backlog). enhancements stay in backlog/prioritization swimlane. i'll add acceptance criteria to each hotfix card.

sara: i'll confirm the two accounts and capture churn risk + business owner to justify hotfix.

javier: i'll update the roadmap doc and slide Q2 tradeoffs — if hotfix lane consumes >40% capacity we move snippet enhancement to later.

maya: action items: alex create tracker cards (label: hotfix, assign org tags), tom scope & estimate hotfix, javier update roadmap, sara confirm customers. no objections by EOD -> i'll lock the plan and kick off the hotfix lane.

opsbot: jira-bot: created RED-3456 "search ordering hotfix — customer A" and linked to dp-874.
